ns2:section.sectionText: ASTR 596 OBS: Observational ISM and Star Formation Advanced undergraduates with an interest in astronomy and star formation can take this course under ASTR 496. Cross-listed with ASTR 496. This course provides a survey of the current status of observational star formation. Particular emphasis will be placed on making and interpreting physical measurements and how they relate to our understanding of star formation. Specifically, this course will discuss the general Interstellar Medium, molecular clouds, low-mass star formation, high-mass star formation, and young clusters.
